name: codex-autopilot
description: Plan, execute, and review bounded Codex workflows with local run captures and a viewer.
author: Gaslit contributors

scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts package.json tsconfig*.json README.md AGENTS.md docs .agents/skills .github
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts package.json tsconfig*.json README.md AGENTS.md docs .agents/skills .github
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run docs:check && npm run format:check && npm run test:package
